data.name: Neuralnx
data.detailed_description:
A retro open-world monster tamer with rage-inducing boss fights. Solo developed.

Brutally difficult. Not for everyone.

CORE PHILOSOPHY: GIT GUD

  • 100% Deterministic – Zero RNG: No critical hits, no accuracy rolls, and no random damage ranges.

  • Battle Transparency: See opponent moves, items, abilities, and stats mid-battle.

  • Competitive-Grade AI: Face Alphalnx, a ruthless opponent driven by multi-turn lookahead and battle simulations.

CREATURES

Based on Real-World Wildlife

Every creature in the game (known as a Lnx) is uniquely designed based on real-world wildlife and features locally inspired naming.

Neuralnx Theme

The game's core lore centers on a neural chip known as the Neuralnx. On the Island of Koral, people have begun using this chip to host Lnx Battles.

THE ALPHALNX ENGINE

The Most Advanced Battle AI

Alphalnx is a multi-pillar AI that evaluates attack sequences, switches, sacrifices, and setup moves through multi-turn lookahead.

Battle Move Simulations

Instead of relying on random weights or predetermined if-else logic, Alphalnx makes decisions by running hundreds of simulations through the actual battle engine to forecast the best possible outcomes.

Alphalnx has zero awareness of game mechanics; it just uses the battle engine to find win paths. Most of the effort used in development was focused on improving Alphalnx, and it was inspired by the success of AlphaGo against the South Korean Go world champion Lee Sedol.

Intentional Weakness

Alphalnx is so strong that it has to be intentionally weakened through its team setups to give the player a chance of winning. This handicap is gradually reduced as you progress, and eventually you'll face Alphalnx at full strength.

Strategic Resource Management (PP)

It was through the process of balancing Alphalnx that I discovered the strategic importance of PP in turn-based games. No other turn-based game currently leverages PP to create a challenging yet winnable experience. By intentionally limiting Alphalnx's PP usage, the player gains a meaningful incentive to learn when to be on offense and when to play defense. Without PP control — especially in the early game — players could never defeat Alphalnx.

100% Deterministic Combat

With zero RNG, every battle outcome rests entirely on your decisions. However, this is a double-edged sword: because the battle is purely deterministic, Alphalnx can calculate flawless, 100% guaranteed win paths if you make a mistake.

Zero Knowledge of Player Moves

Alphalnx is brilliant, but it doesn't cheat. It cannot read your inputs. If it knew your moves in advance, your chances of winning would drop to zero. The only variable Alphalnx cannot perfectly predict is human decision-making. You must outsmart the AI—because without your input, there is no game.

BATTLE TRANSPARENCY

Comparative Stats of Current Combatants

The Stats Scene lets you inspect your opponent's ability, held item, all four moves (with PP, type, power, and category), and compare stats side by side mid-battle. Alphalnx knows all of this — so should you.

Rich Field Effect UI

The battle UI displays remaining turns for weather, terrain, rooms, traps, sleep, and barriers. You always know exactly when effects expire.

On-the-Fly Type Effectiveness

The move selection screen clearly displays type matchups, aiding your decision-making without requiring you to memorize external charts.

SOULSLIKE IDENTITY

Punishing but Fair Difficulty

Calling Neuralnx the "Dark Souls of creature-collection games" is an understatement. This is a grueling, battle-oriented experience. It plays closer to Sekiro—forcing you to overcome challenges using skill and strategy rather than over-leveling or overwhelming the enemy with sheer numbers.

Bonfire Checkpoints

Progression is hard-earned. You can only save your game at designated bonfires. If your entire team faints, you will awaken at the last bonfire you rested at.

Triumph Through Trial and Error

Failing, adapting, and trying again is central to the experience. Victory requires learning the AI's patterns and perfecting your execution.

Strict "Set" Battle Style

Just as Alphalnx isn't warned about your next move, you don't get free information or a free switch-in when an enemy is defeated. Battles flow seamlessly.

No Mid-Battle Consumables

Neither the player nor Alphalnx can use healing items or other consumables as a move option in battle — they are completely removed from the game. Held items, however, are fully allowed.

REWARDING PROGRESSION

Exploration-Based Roster

Every Lnx you acquire is a deliberate reward for exploring the world or defeating bosses. There is no grinding for random encounters to build your team.

Unlockable Capacity

You start with limited resources. Both your active Team Slots and storage Box Slots must be found as loot to expand your capacity over time.

Tactical Team Restrictions

By strictly limiting your Team Slots early on, you cannot brute-force encounters with a numbers advantage. You must defeat the enemy using the exact capacity you have earned.

Meaningful Combat Rewards

There are no traditional shops to buy your way out of a tough spot. Vital items, skill upgrades, and progression materials are earned exclusively through exploration and overcoming difficult foes.

QUALITY OF LIFE

Fast Battle Forfeits

The most important feature in Neuralnx that isn't present in any other creature-collection game. A single misstep against Alphalnx, and you'll already know — or feel — that the fight is lost. If you made the wrong move in your battle plan, Alphalnx will find it. Every battle takes multiple attempts as you search for the weakness embedded in Alphalnx's team setup (see Intentional Weakness above). Forfeiting early is part of the trial-and-error journey toward overcoming Alphalnx.

Universal EXP Share (No Grinding)

Experience is shared across all Lnx you've collected — even those stored in your boxes. This gives you the freedom to prepare various team setups to take on Alphalnx without any grinding.

Instant Post-Battle Healing

After every battle, your team's HP, PP, and status conditions are automatically and fully restored. Consumable held items are also returned to your inventory.

No Wild Encounters

Random grass encounters are gone. All creatures are visible in the overworld. 

Learn Moves and Abilities via Skill Books

Moves and abilities can be learned through Skill Books, which are earned via exploration and combat.

Moves Switchable Anytime

You can switch moves in the overworld at any time.

Abilities Switchable Anytime

You can switch abilities in the overworld at any time.

data.short_description: The Dark Souls of monster taming. Brutally difficult. Face over 300 unique creatures designed to wipe your team. Challenge 78 brutal boss fights that can wall you for days. Rage-inducing. Not for everyone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
